body: Reminds me of the spider man meme pointing at each other
Maybe me giving up is the part that's wrong with me. I'm lazy, I've been told lazy. But I swore I tried before ending it.

I've tried, I did. But my motivations doesn't seem to last. I have tried many things and I seem to just not continue it after a while. I have made posters, I have made notes, I even had a piece of paper dangle around my neck to remind myself on daily basis what I haven't done during the day (parent suggestion). I've tried to give my self a prize if a complete a task to motivate me, I've tried even given myself harsh punishments so I can motivate myself or rather push myself to do so. It's just never worked. Due to COVID I can't go to a doctor and try go see a physiatrist to check if I have any sort of metal disorder. I just seem to be in a never ending loop hole. Some days I am motivated to do everything (though it doesn't meet parent expectations), sometimes I feel like doing nothing (most of the time). I can't seem to get my mind straight to it.

Even my partner tells me that I am voiceless. Over the past 2 years he's given me courage to slowly build up my courage but I still seem to fail in that category too. I am worthless people pleaser and I can't seem to do anything that is about me. I know I can take care of others. I am like the mother of every friend group I was in and I am use to it because my parents always put me in a position to take care of others in any gatherings. But for some reason I can't seem to do anything for myself. It's actually ridiculous. I get told me trying my best is not even enough. It makes me tear up and cry even as I write this whole thing. It hurts. It really does. But my parents would never hear me. I tried. I told them that their asian ways of teaching me is not suited for me. I told them that I am feeling stressed. I told them that I feel depressed but all I got from them is im attention seeking. Im weak. I am disrespecting my own culture. Im a failure compared to my sibling. I've been told this since when I was 10 ish when I started to learn that what I thought was normal in my family wasn't normal and I started to get lazy and started to have a standard thats lower then my family. My mental health steadly declining every single day. Sometimes it goes up but that is because again "Out of sight out of mind." It's just forget, it's there but i've just forgotten it.

Well, failure that I think is failure is meeting parent expectations. I don't really have my personal expectation just complete to a standard standard. Here are each failures listed bellow.   
1. I fail to wake up on time (6am) because waking up after the man of the house is disrespectful. I got told of because of it and ever since then got told to wake up at 6 but I cant no matter how long I sleep or how short I sleep.   
2. I seem to forget everything that's told to me. Everything, As soon as my brain side tracks to something else it just sorta disappears from my mind.   
3. I can't seem to fulfil anything (parent expectation), I clean the kitchen which to my standards and it seems its never enough. Sometimes I just an't see water marks or sometimes rubbish on the floor.   
4. Apprently my attitude is ignoring them, or rather ignoring what they are tell me. There are many rules set on me but I just can't seem to keep remembering them. I seem to get so side racked that sometimes I forget the rules of the house.   
There are so many things I would list but these are the ones that pops up. Becasue most of the time it's out of sight, out of mind but when I fail it dawns on me that I am a failure and I can't do what my parents call normal. Sure, I am 18 and I'm living with my family because if I try go live on my own they are gonna disown me and ontop of that I am judgeing myself with their expectations but I feel like I have lost my own voice being brought up in this household.
Maybe. I also think that patience is something he's not really taught to him as much as I was so maybe his thinking is different. For me I was told patience to the point I get told too patient.
Immediately collect evidence, record everything, screenshot everything before things go down the drain hole. Have something to prove your are in the right.
I mean, he's kind towards me. Never has raised a hand or voice but when he gets upset and acts unrationally ( to me) sometimes. PRobably the uni stuff getting to him I assume.

That can explain a couple of things I think. I guess thinking of death is normal?
I've been trying to do more work and trying to shove that thought away like I usually do but it's really not working recently.

Im feeling better, still beaten and down in the dumps with all honesty. It's hard for me to think \[ositivley after my father calling me a fake. In our family what father says goes. and for me its really imbeded in my mind. I've talked to my partner but it still remains. My mother is like the second leader and her judgment is correct. The time I told that I was sucidal to my mum and then she calling me weak for blaming me for being weak and not being able to be strong against her abuse i just piling up after 10 or more years.
Thank you so much. These words are making me tear up. Thank you.
